# Try any plan for free for 14 days
Every new account unlocks full access to all Crisp features, letting you explore and see if we’re the right fit for your needs.

Trusted by 10,000 companies worldwide

- ### Free

  For solopreneurs and entrepreneurs. Your first shared inbox.

  Free

  Forever

  [Use Crisp for free](https://app.crisp.chat/initiate/signup/?locale=en&plan=free)

  Website chat widget

  Engage with visitors directly on your website.

  2seats included

  No AI credits included

  Destroy silos, centralize conversations, improve internal collaboration and enhance customer satisfaction.

  Shared inbox

  Get everything related to your customer service right in your pocket.

  Mobile applications

  Chat SDKs

  Centralize answers from customizable contact forms within your Crisp Inbox.

  Contact form

  Sync each Crisp conversation with your e-commerce platform: Shopify, Adobe, WooCommerce, and Prestashop.

  E-Commerce integrations

  Stay up to date with your opened conversations.

  Push notifications
- ### Mini

  For early-stage companies who want to improve their customer service.

  $45

  Per month, per workspace

  [Start my trial for free](https://app.crisp.chat/initiate/signup/?locale=en&plan=mini)

  Shared email inbox

  Around 90 automated conversations

  $ 5 included AI credits

  $95

  Per month, per workspace

  Customer data management

  Organize and utilize customer information effectively.

  10seats included

  Around 450 automated conversations

  $ 25 included AI credits

  For medium-sized businesses looking for an AI-powered omnichannel customer support software, plus all our features.

  $295

  Best value

  Advanced analytics

See all features

### A flat pricing per workspace
At Crisp, we offer a straightforward and easy-to-understand pricing model with a flat rate per workspace. This means you pay a single, consistent price regardless of the number of conversations you have each month.
Our approach ensures that you can scale your customer support operations without overspending. With Crisp, you get all the essential tools and AI-powered features your team needs to provide exceptional customer service, all included in one simple, predictable subscription. Simplify your budgeting and focus on what matters most – growing your business and delighting your customers.

pricing-flat-illustration

[Enterprise](#enterprise)

### Enterprise
Created for large-scale companies willing to benefit from dedicated features, custom onboarding and personalized SLAs.

- Dedicated onboarding
- Personalized SLA
- Enhanced rate limits
- Custom features
- Unique pricing
- Team training

Ask for a demo

pricing-faq-illustration

- [Will I pay more for some features?question-expand-icon](#)

  Yes. We may provide some additional features that are not included in your plan, which you can subscribe to, but that's your choice to opt-in for them (eg. paid integrations for specific systems, additional contacts or more than 20 agents in your inbox).
- [Is VAT included in plan prices?question-expand-icon](#)

  VAT is not included in our plan prices. As most Crisp customers are businesses, they do not owe VAT and thus we charge the advertised flat price. VAT is still due for consumers and may be applied on all plan prices (ie. non-business entities).

  If you are an EU business, make sure you enter your EU VAT number to prove your business status and thus remove VAT from the price. If you are located outside the EU, we won't charge any VAT, regardless of your business or consumer status.
- [Do you offer discounts on multiple Crisp Workspaces?question-expand-icon](#)

  Yes! We offer discounts if you are subscribing multiple paid Crisp Workspaces (Crisp Plus and Essentials only) under the same account. We offer 20% off for 3 additional Workspaces. Come chat with us to find the best deal!
- [What does a Crisp Workspace stand for?question-expand-icon](#)

  A Crisp Workspace is the place where you can invite operators to collaborate and answer customer questions.

  A Crisp workspace is tied to a unique identifier. Plans are billed per-Crisp workspace, not per domain and sub-domains.

  As an example, you can have one Crisp workspace which refers to one subscription and connect with the following channels: Instagram, Messenger, or Whatsapp Business, Viber, Line, Telegram, Emails. One and only one of each, except emails, can be centralized in one workspace. You can connect more by subscribing to higher limits.
- [I’m running a nonprofit / I am a student. Do you offer discounts?question-expand-icon](#)

  We offer a 50% discount for nonprofits and students. Chat with us to get your promo code.
- [Is it possible to pay yearly?question-expand-icon](#)

  Yes, it is possible! You can enable yearly payment mode on your Plans page in the Crisp app after you subscribed to a plan (click on the Monthly button, which then becomes Yearly once saved).
- [Why are there no limits on the number of conversations?question-expand-icon](#)

  At Crisp, we believe existing chat platforms are still locked in the past. Why would we bill based on consumption (as all others do), while we are used to unlimited plans everywhere else (mobile carriers, Internet access providers, etc.)? Unlimited is peace of mind at the end of the month; this allows you to allocate more energy to your core business rather than petty subscription policies.
